cell_rules: Run sequential fresh workers with individual cell commands only.
Never repeat completed cells and never invoke the unbounded controller.
Before every launch validate source identity and remaining deadlines.
Cap each timeout before the hard cutoff and stop after a completed cell on failure, identity mismatch, timeout or insufficient window.

forecast.basis: same-state, same-arm measured rep0 fresh-worker outer wall; conservative=max(5,2*measured+1) per cell

order: frozen search manifest order, preserving paired S0-S3 arms within every state and repetition
publication_note: Review copy with user-home paths redacted. Execute from original local artifacts; hashes refer to raw artifacts unless labelled published-copy hashes.
